name: Adjacency-Based Mesh Rebuilding
definition: A method to rebuild chunk meshes only when necessary, specifically when a voxel is added or removed, by identifying and rebuilding adjacent chunks that share a face with the modified voxel.
summary: Adjacency-Based Mesh Rebuilding incrementally regenerates geometry only for a modified voxel's chunk and its face-sharing neighbors, preventing visual artifacts at boundaries while avoiding full-scene rebuilds.
